title: Interest Terms of the Northbeam Store Credit and Financing Accounts
content:
**Condition 7 — Interest on your account.** Interest on an account of the Northbeam Store Credit and Financing Accounts is charged at the rates of the product held, and every product in the range states its own.

7.1 A balance carried on the account is charged at the annual purchase rate of the product held. The rate is an annual percentage.

7.2 A promotional financing plan running on the account is charged at the annual promotional rate of the product held, for as long as that plan runs.

7.3 The account carries a number of grace days on purchases: the days a purchase may be carried without interest where the balance is cleared in full.

## Rates and grace days by product

| Product | Annual purchase rate | Annual promotional rate | Grace days on purchases |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northbeam Store Card | 29.99 per cent | 0.00 per cent | 25 |
| Northbeam Store Card Plus | 27.99 per cent | 0.00 per cent | 25 |
| Northbeam Signature Rewards Card | 24.49 per cent | 0.00 per cent | 25 |
| Northbeam Deferred Interest Promotion Account | 0.00 per cent | 0.00 per cent | 0 |
| Northbeam Business Net Thirty Account | 0.00 per cent | 0.00 per cent | 30 |
| Northbeam Business Fleet Line of Credit | 14.99 per cent | 0.00 per cent | 45 |

## The same terms, read the other way round

- The highest annual purchase rate in the range is the 29.99 per cent of the Northbeam Store Card and the lowest rate above nothing is the 14.99 per cent of the Northbeam Business Fleet Line of Credit.
- Two products in the range, the Northbeam Deferred Interest Promotion Account and the Northbeam Business Net Thirty Account, state an annual purchase rate of 0.00 per cent, so nothing accrues at a purchase rate on either of them.
- The annual promotional rate is 0.00 per cent on all six products, so nothing accrues at a promotional rate anywhere in the range.
- The grace days run from 0 on the Northbeam Deferred Interest Promotion Account to 45 on the Northbeam Business Fleet Line of Credit; where a product states 0 grace days, there is no period on that product during which a purchase is carried free of interest on this basis.
